passages.text: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which faces Jericho. And the LORD showed him the whole land—from Gilead as far as Dan, all of Naphtali, the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea, the Negev, and the region from the Valley of Jericho (the City of Palms) all the way to Zoar.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses went up from the plains of Moab.
He climbed Mount Nebo.
He reached the top of Pisgah.
Pisgah faces Jericho.
The LORD showed Moses the whole land.
The LORD showed him Gilead as far as Dan.
The LORD showed him all of Naphtali.
The LORD showed him the land of Ephraim and Manasseh.
The LORD showed him all the land of Judah as far as the Western Sea.
The LORD showed him the Negev.
The LORD showed him the region from the Valley of Jericho.
Jericho is called the City of Palms.
The LORD showed him the land all the way to Zoar.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל מֹשֶׁ֜ה מֵֽעַרְבֹ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אֶל־ הַ֣ר נְב֔וֹ רֹ֚אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֑וֹ וַיַּרְאֵ֨הוּ יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֶת־ הַגִּלְעָ֖ד עַד־ דָּֽן׃ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ נַפְתָּלִ֔י וְאֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיָּ֥ם הָאַחֲרֽוֹן׃ וְאֶת־ הַנֶּ֗גֶב וְֽאֶת־ הַכִּכָּ֞ר בִּקְעַ֧ת יְרֵח֛וֹ עִ֥יר הַתְּמָרִ֖ים עַד־ צֹֽעַר׃

passages.text: And the LORD said to him, “This is the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have let you see it with your own eyes, but you will not cross into it.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said, "This is the land I promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
I promised to give this land to their descendants.
I have allowed you to see this land with your own eyes.
But you will not enter this land."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו זֹ֤את הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֠שְׁבַּעְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לְזַרְעֲךָ֖ אֶתְּנֶ֑נָּה הֶרְאִיתִ֣יךָ בְעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְשָׁ֖מָּה לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹֽר׃

passages.text: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the servant of the LORD.
Moses died in the land of Moab.
The LORD had said this would happen.
Moses died just as the LORD said.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨מָת שָׁ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד־ יְהוָ֛ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מוֹאָ֖ב עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And He buried him in a valley in the land of Moab facing Beth-peor, and no one to this day knows the location of his grave.
passages.sermon:
God buried Moses.
God buried Moses in a valley.
The valley is in the land of Moab.
The valley faces Beth-peor.
No person knows the location of Moses’ grave.
No one has known the location until today.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֨ר אֹת֤וֹ בַגַּיְ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֔ב מ֖וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֑וֹר וְלֹֽא־ יָדַ֥ע אִישׁ֙ אֶת־ קְבֻ֣רָת֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak, and his vitality had not diminished.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a servant of the LORD.
Moses died in the land of Moab.
Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died.
His eyes were not weak.
His strength had not diminished.
passages.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֗ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים שָׁנָ֖ה בְּמֹת֑וֹ לֹֽא־ כָהֲתָ֥ה עֵינ֖וֹ וְלֹא־ נָ֥ס לֵחֹֽה׃

passages.text: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning for Moses came to an end.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites mourned for Moses.
They were in the plains of Moab.
They grieved for thirty days.
The time of weeping for Moses ended after thirty days.
The time of mourning for Moses ended after thirty days.
passages.original: וַיִּבְכּוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֥ת מוֹאָ֖ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וַֽיִּתְּמ֔וּ יְמֵ֥י בְכִ֖י אֵ֥בֶל מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites obeyed him and did as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua was filled with the spirit of wisdom.
Moses laid his hands on Joshua.
Because of this, Joshua received wisdom.
The Israelites listened to Joshua.
The Israelites obeyed Joshua.
The Israelites did what the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.original: וִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן מָלֵא֙ ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֔ה כִּֽי־ סָמַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ יָדָ֖יו עָלָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ אֵלָ֤יו בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face— no prophet who did all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent Moses to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh and to all his officials and all his land, and no prophet who performed all the mighty acts of power and awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
passages.sermon:
No prophet like Moses has ever risen in Israel since that time.
The LORD knew Moses face to face.
Moses did all the signs and wonders that the LORD sent him to do in Egypt.
Moses did these signs and wonders before Pharaoh.
Moses did them before all Pharaoh’s officials.
Moses did them in all the land of Egypt.
Moses performed mighty acts of power.
Moses did awesome deeds.
Moses did these things in the sight of all Israel.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ קָ֨ם נָבִ֥יא ע֛וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמֹשֶׁ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְדָע֣וֹ יְהוָ֔ה פָּנִ֖ים אֶל־ פָּנִֽים׃ לְכָל־ הָ֨אֹת֜וֹת וְהַמּוֹפְתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁלָחוֹ֙ יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְפַרְעֹ֥ה וּלְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו וּלְכָל־ אַרְצֽוֹ׃ וּלְכֹל֙ הַיָּ֣ד הַחֲזָקָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל הַמּוֹרָ֣א הַגָּד֑וֹל אֲשֶׁר֙ עָשָׂ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
